name: Visi-Prime
headline: Visi-Prime
description: Supports the sharpness and quality of vision. It contains omega-3 fatty acids, vitamins, minerals, lutein and zeaxanthin; helps reduce fatigue under heavy visual load, ease dry-eye symptoms, counter UV damage and slow age-related changes in eye tissue.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Omega-3 fatty acids (from fish oil), lutein, zeaxanthin, vitamins E and B2, zinc, excipients.
